quotes.text:
var lazy = {};
ChromeUtils.defineLazyGetter(lazy, "l10n", () => new Localization(["calendar/calendar.ftl"], true));

# File commands and dialogs
calendar-new = New
calendar-open = Open
filepicker-title-import = Import
filepicker-title-export = Export

# Filters for export/import/open file picker.  $wildmat will be replaced with
# wildmat used to filter files by extension, such as (*.html; *.htm).
filter-ics = iCalendar ({ $wildmat })

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: openLocalCalendar uses calendar-open from calendar/calendar.ftl. The old generic open ID was missing in that bundle, producing an empty native picker title. Keep the localized ID and the Localization bundle paired; similar English text does not make an ID interchangeable. The .ics filter uses a separately localized description with the wildmat argument. This fixes the static title lookup; a native picker’s accessible name and announcements still need a runtime check.
title: Resolve the file-picker title in its actual Fluent bundle
